name: Ruvo

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 or certification mentioned on ruvo.com; only generic 'market-audited protocols' and 'periodic audits with independent partners', no trust/security page
Relies on partner Crossmint's SOC 2 Type II certified infrastructure -- Crossmint's cert, not Ruvo's own

aws_evidence: Site mentions only generic 'secure cloud storage'; no provider named
pitch_note: Fresh $4.6M seed fintech with business accounts and no SOC 2 of its own (it leans on Crossmint's certified infra), so an attestation pitch lands as it courts business customers. Brazil HQ and consumer-first product temper the fit.

name: SuretyNow

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2, trust page, or compliance badge anywhere on suretynow.com; only 'encrypted forms' claim. B2B insurance/surety platform serving regulated bonding processes
Web search for 'SuretyNow SOC 2' returned no compliance or trust-center results

pitch_note: B2B insurance/surety platform handling sensitive applicant financials with zero visible compliance posture -- a natural SOC 2 candidate. But a 4-person team on YC-only money with no hiring means budget and urgency are unproven.

name: Clarion

soc2_evidence.signal: Homepage claims 'Enterprise-grade security' and 'protected patient data and complete audit trails' but shows no SOC 2 badge, no HIPAA cert, no Vanta/Drata badge, and no trust/security page
Sells to enterprise healthcare buyers: outpatient health systems, virtual care companies, and a $5B publicly traded health insurer -- buyers that demand SOC 2 in vendor review

hiring_signals: 9 open roles including Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, and Founding Product Designer (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/clarion/jobs)
aws_evidence: No cloud provider named on site or job listings; CTO previously built voice AI at Amazon Alexa (background only, not stack evidence)
pitch_note: Prime ICP: $5.4M-seeded healthcare AI selling to health systems and a $5B public insurer, hiring across 9 roles, yet no SOC 2 badge or trust page -- enterprise procurement will force an attestation soon and they have the budget for it.

name: Hazel

soc2_evidence.signal: AICPA SOC 2 badge displayed in the footer of hazelai.com

aws_evidence: No cloud provider mentioned on site or in job posting; no StateRAMP/FedRAMP listed despite govtech focus
pitch_note: Disqualified for Type I: already displays an AICPA SOC 2 badge on its site. Only residual angle is ongoing monitoring/Type II renewal or future StateRAMP/FedRAMP work as it lands agencies like the City of Dallas and Navy customers.

name: Miden

soc2_evidence.signal: Site advertises PCI-DSS compliance and 'bank-grade security' but no SOC 2 and no trust/security page
B2B card issuer-processor selling to financial institutions and businesses -- regulated buyer category; search for 'Miden SOC 2' found nothing

pitch_note: B2B fintech infrastructure with financial-institution buyers, PCI-DSS but no SOC 2 -- technically a fit. However it is Nigeria-based, sells into Sub-Saharan Africa where ISO/PCI dominate over SOC 2, and shows no hiring, so demand for a US attestation is uncertain. (Note: the $25M 'Miden' seed in press is the unrelated Polygon Miden crypto project.)

name: Closure

soc2_evidence.signal: Site prominently displays SOC 2 Type II, CJIS, and HIPAA compliance plus a Trust Center, validated by third-party audits and pen tests

pitch_note: Disqualified: already holds SOC 2 Type II alongside CJIS and HIPAA with a public Trust Center -- the most compliance-mature company in this slice. No Type I opportunity here.

name: Toothy AI

soc2_evidence.signal: Site claims HIPAA compliance but no SOC 2 badge or trust page found

Founding Lead Engineer job explicitly requires implementing 'HIPAA, MFA across remote desktops/jumphosts, SOC2/HITRUST' security and compliance practices -- they are staffing for SOC 2 now and have no dedicated GRC function

hiring_signals: Founding Lead Engineer with infrastructure/DevOps and SOC2/HITRUST compliance-implementation duties, $100K-$200K + 0.5-2% equity (https://www.workatastartup.com/jobs/74334)
aws_evidence: Job posting cites 'multi-cloud/hybrid environments', CI/CD, and containerization but names no provider; also runs Windows RPA systems
pitch_note: Strongest lead in the slice: healthcare AI handling PHI and insurance data, just closed a seed after 30x batch growth, and its founding-engineer job posting literally lists SOC2/HITRUST implementation as a duty -- they need SOC 2 help right now and have not yet built the function in-house.

name: Amby Health

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 certification or trust page found in searches or on site; privacy policy acknowledges handling HIPAA/CMIA-covered health data
Sells AI billing/QA copilot to ambulance agencies and fire departments (regulated healthcare + government buyers)

pitch_note: PHI-handling EMS copilot selling into ambulance agencies and fire departments -- buyers who will demand SOC 2 in procurement -- with no attestation in sight. Fit is capped by the 2-person team, pre-seed budget, and no hiring signals yet.
